'''Animated mithril armour''' is a player-created foe encountered at the [[Warriors' Guild]]. To summon one, players must use a [[mithril platebody]], [[mithril platelegs]], and a [[mithril full helm]] on the [[magical animator]]. It is commonly used to farm [[Warrior guild token|tokens]], because its lower stats make it quicker to defeat and it always drops all three armour pieces.

Whilst the mithril variant is considered to be a relatively easy target, it is still advised to bring along some food since it can hit up to 10. The player will always have all of their [[mithril armour]] parts returned to them when it is defeated; however, any armour below [[Animated Black Armour|black]] will lose pieces.

Like all other animated armour variants, it is immune to [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] attacks. As a result of being immune to Ranged damage, the armour is effectively immune to [[burn]], which will be inflicted but reduced to 0 damage. It is also immune to [[poison]] and [[venom]].
